title: 녹아내려
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop R&B ballad. Clean electric guitar plays a jazz-influenced chord progression with subtle chorus and reverb. A warm synth bass enters on the downbeats. The drum kit features a crisp snare with a short decay and a soft kick drum. Female vocals are breathy and intimate, utilizing a mix of chest voice and airy falsetto. The arrangement is sparse, focusing on the interplay between the vocal melody and the rhythmic guitar strumming. Tempo is 82 BPM in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar with light chorus, syncopated jazz chords]

[Verse 1]
[breathy female vocals]
미동도 없이 소리가 째깍여 [warm synth bass enters]
도시 창에 번져
네온이 얼굴을 칠해
빨강 파랑 노랑
이어폰을 써
모르는 노래가 흘러 그게 좋아
모르는 게 좋아
창에 입김 불어
아무도 안 불러
이 시간은 나만 있어

[Chorus]
[vocals shift to a more melodic, soaring tone]
녹아내려 도시가
창
